parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalization, facility ban, border restriction, or documented police targeting appears in the record. Decriminalized same-sex conduct, civil unions, Pride participation, and an elected openly gay leader suggest a relatively tolerant climate, though primarily as LGBT rather than trans-specific evidence. Negative signals are thinner and mostly open questions: lack of gender-identity protections, no nonbinary recognition, trans rights treated as marginal, and resident-linked document/marriage consequences. LGB hate-attack cases show social hostility and uneven enforcement, but not organized trans targeting; international court pressure and reopened cases partially mitigate. Absent documented universal-exposure measures, risk sits in reduced rather than elevated range, below clearer traveler-protective jurisdictions.
